svg.title: Component sheet — transport and continuous controls
svg.desc: Seek, volume, EQ, repeat and visualization controls with keyboard steps and explicit semantics.
svg.text: Sliders expose values and keyboard steps. Waveform seeking is a separate action from visualization pause.
Repeat states: Off → All → One. Never use color alone.
Drag to preview time; commit on release. Arrow = 5 s; Shift = 30 s. Live streams disable seeking.
Arrow = 1%; Page = 5%; Home/End = min/max. Mute is a separate toggle.
EQ BAND / NUMERIC VALUE ALWAYS AVAILABLE
SVG is the presentation layer. Audio analysis supplies data; pausing visuals does not pause audio.
